concept.reason: Actual fossil display and close skull photo sufficient for original morphological gate; no extra concept image.

scope: Complete small ceratopsian retaining low short frill and deep compact hornless head; full torso, four limbs and tapering tail, not a skull-only study.

scientific_limits.en: Artistic living reconstruction. Actual Canadian Museum of Nature fossil display includes multiple partial skeletons and disarticulated bones, not a single in-life articulated pose. Royal Tyrrell skull is a separate exhibit from Tolman Bridge; do not label it CMN8889 or associate it with the photographed skeletons. Surface restoration/compression and soft-tissue shape are uncertain.3m is NHM genus estimate, not a measurement of any illustrated individual. Tail completion, body breadth, stance, beak sheath and colour are reconstructed.
scientific_limits.zh: 完整活体美术复原。加拿大自然博物馆实物展板包含多个部分骨架和散骨，并非单个活体姿势。Tyrrell头骨是Tolman Bridge的另一个展品，不标成CMN8889，也不宣称与展板骨架同体。表面补配、压扁与软组织形态存在不确定性。3米为NHM属级估值，非任何所示个体实测。尾部补全、躯宽、站姿、喙鞘与颜色为复原。

scale.basis: NHM Dino Directory genus estimate, not measured photographed specimen; do not label as CMN8889 length.

diagnostic_targets: Deep compact hornless skull with strongly downturned beak and deep lower jaw.
Short low rear skull shelf/frill close to head; not large upright Protoceratops shield.
No nasal or brow horn, no elaborate frill spikes.
Compact ribcage with robust hindlimbs and shorter forelimbs; four limbs in neutral supported stance.
Complete relatively long tapering tail, no club, plates or Psittacosaurus bristle claim.
specimen_basis: Actually viewed Canadian Museum of Nature fossil exhibit photo by Hectonichus and Royal Tyrrell Tolman Bridge skull photo by Etemenanki3; two separate fossil contexts.
acceptance_checks: Original low short frill plus deep compact hornless head readable jointly in side/front/perspective.
Do not turn into small Triceratops or tall-frilled Protoceratops: no facial horns or tall broad shield.
Full organism not fossil slab: reject copied burial pose or combined duplicate legs from multiple individuals.
Four limbs and complete tail; no unsupported tail bristles or armor.
Four views only; soft tissues and scale remain reconstruction estimates.
